description: This file defines the PHP class `HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Iframe`, which provides an implementation of an HTML iframe module within the HTMLPurifier library. It includes configuration-based setup for iframe attributes and safety features.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Iframe
classes.description: A class representing the iframe module in the HTMLPurifier library, responsible for defining iframe-specific attributes and safety settings.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures iframe element attributes based on provided configuration, including safety options.
